label: Proof Led
description: Serious B2B product landing that leads with logos, numbers, and one case study. For buyers who need evidence before a demo — not a friendly growth cartoon.
signatureMotif: logo row first, hard numbers, and one deep case study
promptHints: Put proof above charm: logo strip, 3 hard metrics, then a single case study with a quote and a result number. Product UI can wait until after proof.
CTA is Book a demo or Talk to sales — never Start free trial as the only action if the prompt is enterprise.
Keep the page light and measured. No terminal aesthetic, no playful blobs.

layouts: Hero is a short claim + subclaim + two CTAs, then an immediate logo row of 5–8 customer marks on a hairline. No illustrated 3D product hero.
Directly under logos: three large numerals (time saved, revenue, teams) with a one-line source each — not icon-feature cards.
One case-study band: company name, 80-word story, one quote, one result, and a text link to a longer story. Optional muted product screenshot after the story.
Pricing or demo form comes last, after proof. Comparison table is acceptable; friendly three-tier cartoon cards are not the lead.
motifs: Cool gray-white ground, ink text, one restrained blue or slate primary. Logos in grayscale.
Manrope headings at 40–56px, Inter body 16–18px. Numbers use tabular figures and a tight label above.
Screenshots are framed as evidence, cropped and muted, never a glowing glass mockup.
antiPatterns: Do not use friendly-saas pastel blobs, playful illustrations, or a cute product cartoon as the hero.
Avoid dev-terminal: dark canvas, mono headings, and CLI-first storytelling.
No 3-up icon feature grid as the first section after the hero.
Avoid testimonial carousels of generic avatars without a company name or a measurable result.
